C x.di-interface-at-boundaries EX ARC-021,ARC-007 DEFAULT ;; Use interface-to-implementation registration at architectural boundaries (Application services, repositories, adapters); concrete registration is fine for implementation-only helpers. ;; = ;; none ;; Registration convention not in the oracle.
C gov012.di-explicit-first OL GOV-012,GOV-013 PREFER ;; Prefer explicit registration in small/medium applications; add scanning, keyed services, factories or decorators only when they solve an actual composition problem or genuine boilerplate. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.di-keyed-when EX ARC-021 DEFAULT ;; Use keyed services when several implementations of one abstraction are selected by a known key and a single registration or simple factory is not clearer. ;; = ;; none ;; Technique guidance not in the oracle.
C dep001.di-no-scrutor-for-one OL DEP-001,GOV-013 MUST_NOT ;; Do not add Scrutor for one decoration when normal composition is simpler. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.di-scan-owning-assembly EX ARC-023 MUST ;; Scan the assembly that owns the services, not accidentally only the Api assembly. ;; = ;; none ;; Not in the oracle.
C arc022.di-scope-per-operation OL ARC-022 MUST ;; A singleton or hosted service needing scoped work creates a scope per operation. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.di-scoped-orchestration EX ARC-022,ARC-006 MUST ;; Within that scope resolve a scoped orchestration service, not Infrastructure internals. ;; = ;; none ;; Not in the oracle.
C arc022.di-captive OL ARC-022 MUST_NOT ;; Registering an Application service using repositories/Unit of Work as a singleton is a captive-dependency bug; register it scoped. ;; = ;; none ;;

C gov014.dw-frame-scope OL GOV-014,WF-004 MUST ;; Determine the requested scope and touched areas first. ;; = ;; none ;;
C gov002.read-spec OL GOV-002,GOV-008 MUST ;; For a new application or substantial feature read SPECIFICATION.md (and feature specifications) before planning or implementing; read CUSTOM_SETTINGS.md when tunable values are involved. ;; = ;; none ;;
C gov017.dw-raise-early OL GOV-017,GOV-018 MUST ;; Check the request against Challenge and Decision control; raise concerns and Decision Requests before writing code. ;; = ;; none ;;
C wf001.dw-read-owners OL WF-001 MUST ;; Read the governing rule files explicitly whenever they may not have loaded, always for greenfield work, new projects or features in unopened areas. ;; = ;; none ;;
C wf001.inspect-apply OL WF-001 MUST ;; Before any non-trivial change inspect relevant existing code (callers, contracts, tests, configuration) and apply the governing rules and skills. ;; = ;; none ;;
C gov014.dw-scope OL GOV-014 MUST ;; Keep the change inside the requested scope. ;; = ;; none ;;
C tst009.regression OL TST-009 DEFAULT ;; For a meaningful bug with plausible recurrence add a regression test unless equivalent coverage exists. ;; = ;; Equivalent coverage exists. ;;
C x.dw-fail-before-pass EX TST-009 MUST ;; The regression test fails before the fix and passes after it. ;; = ;; none ;; Not in TST-009.
C run012.perf-change OL RUN-012 MUST ;; Performance changes identify the bottleneck, preserve behaviour, use the simplest effective optimization, keep/add tests and benchmark/profile non-obvious complex optimizations. ;; = ;; none ;;
C gov007.dw-durable-source OL GOV-007,GOV-021 MUST ;; When a new behavioural rule is approved update the durable source of truth in the same change (SPECIFICATION.md when appropriate); tunable values go through custom-settings. ;; = ;; none ;;
C pst008.dw-seed-cochange OL PST-008,PST-001 MUST ;; Whenever Domain/persistence changes affect seeded entities update the seeder in the same change so that recreating the Development database yields valid representative data. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.dw-migration-project EX ARC-019 DEFAULT ;; Create schema changes as new EF Core migrations from the Infrastructure project with the Api project as startup project. ;; = ;; none ;; Migration command technique not in the oracle.
C pst010.dw-review OL PST-010 MUST ;; Treat migrations as source code and review each generated migration before committing (destructive changes, column recreation, data migrations, indexes, FKs, delete behaviour). ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.dw-tests-for-changes EX TST-002,TST-009 MUST ;; Changed behaviour gets maintained automated coverage at the right level. ;; = ;; none ;; General test co-change obligation not in the oracle.
C wf002.dw-review OL WF-002 MUST ;; For substantial feature work or a new application run code-review (or the code-reviewer agent) before final verification and address real findings. ;; = ;; none ;;
C wf003.dw-verify OL WF-003,WF-005,WF-009 MUST ;; Run verify before declaring completion; a change is not complete while verification fails or is unreported. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.dw-report EX WF-009 MUST ;; Report what changed, the verify result block and remaining known issues. ;; = ;; none ;; Report fields not in the oracle.
C gov017.dw-report-unresolved OL GOV-017 MUST ;; Report unresolved Decision Requests. ;; = ;; none ;;

C arc002.docker-out-of-core OL ARC-002,ARC-008 MUST_NOT ;; Keep Docker concerns out of Domain/Application code. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.dk-restore-layering EX DEP-019 DEFAULT ;; Copy only existing needed repository build files, copy project files explicitly before the source tree for restore caching, update when structure changes, avoid flattening wildcard tricks. ;; = ;; none ;; Dockerfile technique not in the oracle.
C dep019.dk-worker-runtime OL DEP-019 DEFAULT ;; Workers without ASP.NET Core use the plain .NET runtime image. ;; = ;; none ;;
C dep019.dk-no-root OL DEP-019 MUST_NOT ;; Make written directories owned/permitted correctly instead of switching to root. ;; = ;; none ;;
C sec001.dk-secrets OL SEC-001,SEC-002 MUST ;; Supply secrets through the platform/container secret mechanism; build arguments are visible in image metadata and copied appsettings ship inside the image. ;; = ;; none ;;
C gov013.dk-only-used-infra OL GOV-013,WF-017 MUST ;; Add only infrastructure the project actually uses to Compose (not PostgreSQL/Redis/RabbitMQ because examples have them). ;; = ;; none ;;
C sec001.dk-env-file OL SEC-001,SEC-002 MUST ;; Keep local passwords in an ignored .env file. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.dk-health-probes EX API-019 PREFER ;; Expose liveness/readiness via ASP.NET Core health checks, prefer orchestrator HTTP probes, verify curl/wget/shell availability before in-container health commands and weigh adding debugging packages to production images. ;; = ;; none ;; Probe mechanics not in the oracle.
C x.dk-angular-static EX DEP-018 DEFAULT ;; Build Angular in a Node stage and serve output with the chosen hosting strategy (Nginx not mandatory); keep API base URLs compatible with the deployment. ;; = ;; none ;; Not in the oracle.
C x.dk-dockerignore EX DEP-019 MUST_NOT ;; Do not exclude tests the image build runs, or files restore/build needs, in .dockerignore. ;; = ;; none ;; Not in the oracle.
C x.dk-image-optimization EX RUN-008,DEP-019 DEFAULT ;; Start with standard supported images; Alpine/chiseled/trimming/Native AOT only when compatibility and deployment requirements justify them, then verify globalization, native dependencies, reflection and diagnostics. ;; = ;; none ;; Not in the oracle.

135 MX [tst004.dt-no-delays,x.dt-no-assertion-free] ;; Task.Delay timing, mocking every class and Testcontainers without fidelity need restate TST-004/TST-003/TST-007; assertion-free tests are an added anti-pattern.
137 NN ;; Heading.
139-149 DU ;; Decision table restating the technique above.

C gov013.test-infra-need OL GOV-013 MUST_NOT ;; Do not build test infrastructure without a concrete testing need. ;; = ;; none ;;
C tst005.case-tables OL TST-005 DEFAULT ;; A longer explicit table beats a shorter algorithmic test; prefer [TestCase] over loops, LINQ or TestCaseSource deriving expectations; multi-step tests when the sequence is the scenario. ;; = ;; none ;;
C tst003.dt-no-mechanical-mocks OL TST-003 MUST_NOT ;; Mock or fake architectural boundaries when it clarifies behaviour; do not mock every collaborator mechanically. ;; = ;; none ;;
C tst003.dt-app-services OL TST-003 MUST ;; Application Service tests assert use-case results and meaningful side effects; call-count assertions only when the interaction is part of the contract. ;; = ;; none ;;
C tst006.dt-prefer-integration OL TST-006,TST-002 DEFAULT ;; When behaviour depends heavily on EF Core semantics, transactions, DI, serialization or HTTP prefer an integration test. ;; = ;; none ;;
C tst004.dt-testing-env OL TST-004 MUST_NOT ;; Configure the Testing environment so it can never reach a Development or Production database. ;; = ;; none ;;
C tst007.dt-db-strategy OL TST-007 DEFAULT ;; Use the real provider when fidelity matters (Testcontainers optional); a lighter isolated relational database may be acceptable when it does not, stating the trade-off; EF InMemory only for narrow cases where relational semantics are irrelevant. ;; = ;; none ;;
C tst008.dt-known-state OL TST-008,TST-004 MUST ;; Known starting state: recreate/reset the isolated database, use transactions when they fit, seed only needed data, use unique identifiers. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.dt-persistence-tests EX TST-011,TST-003 DEFAULT ;; Test repositories/mappings only for meaningful behaviour (custom mappings, filters, projections, non-trivial queries, relationships, concurrency, provider behaviour), not one test per trivial Add/Get. ;; = ;; none ;; Not in the oracle.
C tst004.dt-external OL TST-004 MUST ;; Use fakes/stub handlers/local fake servers for external dependencies (sandbox only when explicitly targeted); keep slow or unreliable external tests out of the fast run. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.dt-test-data-builders EX TST-005 DEFAULT ;; Keep test data explicit and minimal; introduce builders/fixtures/factories only when repeated setup becomes hard to read. ;; = ;; none ;; Not in the oracle.
C tst010.dt-probes OL TST-010 MUST ;; Ad-hoc probes usually become WebApplicationFactory tests; verify an existing test really exercises the behaviour instead of duplicating; review probes before keeping them. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.dt-smoke-definition EX TST-005 DEFINITION ;; 'Smoke test' means a small set of fast checks that a built/deployed application is basically operational; prefer explicit assertions over snapshots for small or important contracts. ;; = ;; none ;; Not in the oracle.
C gov013.dt-no-snapshot-default OL GOV-013,DEP-001 MUST_NOT ;; Do not add a snapshot-testing library by default. ;; = ;; none ;;
C tst004.dt-no-delays OL TST-004,TST-003,TST-007 AVOID ;; Avoid Task.Delay to make timing tests pass, mocking every class and Testcontainers without a fidelity need. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.dt-no-assertion-free EX TST-003 AVOID ;; Avoid assertion-free tests unless the behaviour is 'does not throw'. ;; = ;; none ;; Not in the oracle.
